scope_label: technical-interaction roof in a House of Quality
definition: In a House of Quality, the correlation matrix is a roof-shaped grid for assessing how proposed technical characteristics interact with one another.
explanation: A positive mark suggests that changes may reinforce one another; a negative mark flags a possible conflict or trade-off. The meaning of each mark depends on the method and evidence used.
In this use, “correlation” need not mean a calculated statistical correlation coefficient. The roof records design judgments unless a separate analysis establishes measured relationships.
